title: Grip It Like You Mean It (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections rooster strut southern drawl
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say, I say, son
C for cat, h for ha, a for apple, s for stupid
That spells Chas
Now listen up boy, golf grip lesson one

[Verse 1]
Ten fingers on the leather, that's the overlap way
Left hand crowns the handle, right hand comes to play
Right pinky rides the left index, that's the bridge
Grip pressure four out of ten, hold it on the ridge

[Pre-Chorus]
Not too tight, not too loose
Light as holding a tube of paste, son
Dont squeeze it out the top, dont squeeze it out the top

[Chorus]
Grip it like you mean it, swing it like you breathe
V's pointing to the shoulder, that's the line you weave
Four out of ten, son, four out of ten
Let the club do the work and you swing again

[Verse 2]
Thumb pad down the shaft, a quarter inch from the top
Knuckles two and a half showing, that's where the good shots drop
Weak grip the ball flies right, strong grip it curves home
Neutral's where you living if you wanna own the zone

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say son, the grip is the steering wheel
The grip is everything, boy, the grip is the deal
Four out of ten, two and a half knuckles
Now walk it back and do it again

[Chorus]
Grip it like you mean it, swing it like you breathe
V's pointing to the shoulder, that's the line you weave
Four out of ten, son, four out of ten
Let the club do the work and you swing again

[Outro]
That's my boy, that's my boy
Grip pressure four, walk it back
Do it again, do it again
